texts.zh: 我们在[mega_art_installation_system.GetName]中发现了三座被毁的空间站。它们被一团碎片所环绕，其中某些仍可辨识出是艺术品，虽然是非常异星的艺术品——看来这里曾是一座“巨型艺术设施”。
texts.en: A trio of wrecked space stations have been discovered in [mega_art_installation_system.GetName]. They are surrounded by a cloud of debris, some of which is still vaguely recognizable as works of art, albeit of a very alien nature. It seems that this was at one point a "Mega Art Installation".

texts.zh: 我们在[mega_art_installation_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的“巨型艺术设施”。其中的展品已遭受了时间与真空的摧残。
texts.en: A ruined "Mega Art Installation" has been discovered in [mega_art_installation_system.GetName]. Time and vacuum-exposure have not been kind to the exhibits.
